title: fix(xtask): end a silent gate step by itself and name it (STALL row)
body:
A post-merge step that hangs now ends by itself. The gate names the step, and the report does not open "main is red" for it.

## What changed

- `xtask/src/watchdog.rs` (new): the stall watchdog. It reads the stall time, waits for a child with a deadline on silence, reads and kills the process tree, writes the STALL log line, prints the STALL report and gives the exit code.
- `xtask/src/direct.rs`: `run` (test executables) and `cargo` (cargo steps, with the piped JSON stdout of a recording build) start the child with `spawn` and wait through `watchdog::wait`. A stalled executable ends its step.
- `xtask/src/exec.rs`: `Done.stall`, the `STALL` row (`row`), the stall note, the plan line of the watchdog, and the exit code through `watchdog::exit_code`. `expect_fail_note` and `panic_block` moved to `known_fail.rs` without a change (re-exported), so `exec.rs` stays under 400 lines.
- `xtask/src/exit_status.rs`: its test passes the new `limit` argument.
- `.github/workflows/post-merge.yml`: the step "Batch gate tier" has `id: gate` and `timeout-minutes: 45` (the job cap of 90 stays). It writes `gate-start.txt`. "Gate summary" appends `gate step TIMEOUT after <n> min; last started step: <line>` when the step did not succeed, wrote no summary and ran 44 minutes or more. The gate job exports `runner: ${{ runner.name }}`, and the report step reads it as `RUNNER`. No trigger, `runs-on` or permission changed.
- `.github/scripts/post-merge-report.sh`: the runner-stall case (below).
- `AGENTS.md`: the rule **Runner stops**.
- `.claude/skills/gate/SKILL.md`: section "Stall watchdog". `.claude/skills/runners/SKILL.md`: the stall lines of the post-merge gate.
- `docs/decisions/3303-gate-stall-watchdog.md`: the decisions.

## The watchdog rules and defaults

- Output is the growth of the step log plus the bytes of a piped stdout. The child and each descendant write to the same log handle, so the output of a descendant counts.
- A debug step with no output for 15 minutes is a stall.
- A `--release` or `--ignored` step gets 4 times the time: 60 minutes. One heavy test or a release link can be silent for a long time, and libtest has no stable output for each test while it runs.
- `CAMCRAFT_GATE_STALL_MIN=<n>` sets the time in whole minutes. It uses the parse rules of `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS`: a bad value uses the default and prints a diagnostic.
- At a stall the gate reads the tree (`ps -A -o pid= -o ppid= -o comm=` on Unix, `Win32_Process` on Windows), then kills it (`kill -KILL <pids>`, or `taskkill /F /T /PID`).
- It prints `STALL <minutes>min <step>`, the last 20 lines of the step and the processes that were alive.
- The log gets `error: gate watchdog: STALL <m>min: ...`, so `--failed` selects the step again.
- The summary row is `STALL`, not `FAIL`. The other steps go on.
- Exit code: 3 for `STALL` rows only; 1 for a `FAIL` row or a void run (as before); else 0.

## The three report cases

1. A green run: as before.
2. `FAIL` rows (also when there are `STALL` rows): a red main, as before. The script opens or comments on `main is red (post-merge gate)`.
3. No `FAIL` row, but a `STALL` row or the timeout line: a runner stall. The script writes this text and exits 0, with no issue write:
   `::warning title=runner stall::runner stall: <step> on <runner> at <sha> (<run url>); not a red main, no issue opened`
   It opens nothing and comments on nothing. #3303 closes with this PR, and a fixed issue number in a script goes out of date. The coordinator logs the stall on #3303 and re-runs the run one time (AGENTS.md **Runner stops**). The report job's token keeps `contents: read` and `issues: write` only.

A red run with no summary and no timeout line (for example xtask did not build) stays case 2, with the generic text.

## Tests

- `cargo test -p xtask -j 6` (Windows): green. `xtask` bin: `test result: ok. 282 passed; 0 failed`; each integration binary `ok` (largest: 4, 4, 3, 3, 3 passed), 0 failed
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -j 6 -- -D warnings`: green (`Finished`, exit 0, no warning from xtask)
- Pinning tests (`xtask/src/watchdog_tests.rs`). The children are the xtask test executable itself (`watchdog_helper`), so they work on each platform:
  - `a_silent_step_is_killed_as_a_tree_and_named`: a silent child with a silent grandchild. Stall time 2 s. It stalls, the grandchild dies, the log has the STALL line, `--failed` selects it, and the note reads `stall: no output for 1min`.
  - `output_of_the_child_or_a_descendant_keeps_the_step_alive`: a child that writes, and a silent child whose grandchild writes, run to their end.
  - `the_stall_time_reads_as_the_job_budget_does`, `release_and_ignored_steps_get_the_longer_stall_time`, `a_stall_has_its_own_row_and_exit_code`, `the_process_tree_follows_the_parent_links`.
- `xtask/tests/post_merge_stall.rs`: the workflow lines (step id, step timeout, job cap, the env lines), and (Unix only, as `post_merge_report.rs`) the four script cases with a fake `gh`. On this Windows machine I ran the four script cases by hand in Git Bash with a fake `gh`: the STALL row and the timeout line gave the warning and no `gh` call; the FAIL row and the no-summary case gave `issue create`.
- `bash -n` on `post-merge-report.sh` and on each `run:` block of `post-merge.yml`. A YAML parse of `post-merge.yml` (Python `yaml.safe_load`): `on:` is still `push: main` and `workflow_dispatch`; the batch step has `timeout-minutes: 45`.
- The test stall time goes in as a parameter, not through the variable. The variable is in whole minutes, and `set_var` is unsafe in edition 2024 and races with parallel tests.

## Not exercised

- A real stalled run on a runner. The timeout line and the `runner` output have not run on GitHub.
- That GitHub gives a timed-out step the outcome `failure` (the check accepts each outcome that is not `success`).
- The Unix test runs of `post_merge_stall.rs` (this machine is Windows; the same cases ran by hand in Git Bash).
- The Linux and macOS process-tree code (`ps`, `kill`); only the Windows path ran. No batch, heavy or release gate ran.

## After the review (head fac4e34ba)

The review of be5d2ffce found two blockers in the report path. Both fixes are in `fac4e34ba`:

- A step timeout hid an earlier FAIL. The gate prints `     FAIL in <n>s ...` when each step ends, but the summary comes only at the end. Now a `FAIL in` line is a red main in every case. This includes a run with no summary, a STALL row or the timeout line. Without a summary, the issue lists those lines. "Gate summary" also writes no timeout line after a `FAIL in` line.
- `grep -q` in a pipe under `pipefail` could read a FAIL row as no match (SIGPIPE on a summary over 64 KiB). The script now uses no `grep -q` in a pipe: it uses here-strings and greps on the file. In the workflow, the "last started step" grep has `|| true`, because GitHub runs `shell: bash` with `-eo pipefail`, and a grep with no match would end the step.
- Notes done in the same push:
  - STALL comes from `End::Stalled` through `direct::run` / `direct::cargo`, not from a scan of the log text.
  - AGENTS.md **Runner stops**: a second STALL of the same step at the same commit is a red main.
  - The decision file names the gaps of the parent-pid kill. Follow-up: #3493 (P7).
- New pinning tests:
  - `post_merge_stall::script::a_step_that_ended_red_before_a_timeout_stays_a_red_main`
  - `post_merge_stall::script::a_large_summary_with_fail_and_stall_rows_stays_a_red_main` (about 197 KB of summary)
  - `watchdog_tests::a_stall_report_without_the_watchdog_line_still_names_the_step`
- Readings on `fac4e34ba` (Windows):
  - `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -j 6 -- -D warnings`: green.
  - `cargo test -p xtask -j 6`: `test result: ok. 283 passed; 0 failed`, and each integration binary is ok with 0 failed.
  - The six script cases, run by hand in Git Bash with a fake `gh`:
    - STALL row: warning, no issue write.
    - Timeout line: warning, no issue write.
    - FAIL row with a STALL row: red.
    - No summary: red.
    - `FAIL in` line before a timeout: red, and the issue lists the line.
    - 197 KB summary with FAIL and STALL rows: red.
  - The "Gate summary" block under `bash -eo pipefail`, for a hang, a `FAIL in` line and no step lines: each exits 0, and the timeout line is written only for the hang and the no-lines case.
  - `bash -n` passed, and the YAML parse shows the triggers unchanged.
- Not exercised: the `#[cfg(unix)]` script tests (this machine is Windows), and the Unix `ps` / `kill` path.

Process change: yes

Effort: medium

Changelog: none

Fixes #3303
